summary: Bound monitor-agent structured extraction prompt and open incident evidence summaries to prevent LLM prompt length limit 502 errors.
scope: services/monitor-agent/monitor_agent.py: bound build_prompt with per-incident summary truncation (MAX_INCIDENT_SUMMARY_CHARS = 1000) and total prompt cap (MAX_PROMPT_CHARS = 120000) with omitted incident counting
services/monitor-agent/test_monitor_agent.py: unit tests for prompt bounding with 50 large incidents and omitted incident counting
services/incident/incident.py: bound _merge_summary to MAX_EVIDENCE_SUMMARY_LENGTH (4000) with older entries dropped marker and reduce oversized stored summaries on next merge
services/incident/test_incident.py: unit tests for evidence summary merge bounding at 4000 chars and reduction of pre-existing oversized summaries

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1: The prompt monitor-agent sends to the structured route stays at or below 120000 characters no matter how many open incidents exist or how long their summaries are; verified in test_build_prompt_bounds_prompt_with_50_large_incidents and test_run_once_sends_bounded_prompt_with_50_large_open_incidents using 50 open incidents each carrying a 200000 character summary.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2: Each incident in the monitor prompt keeps its title and cluster and a summary cut to a fixed per-incident limit with a visible truncation marker (... [truncated]); incidents left out because of the total limit are counted in the prompt (OMITTED_INCIDENTS count) and not silently dropped. Verified in test_build_prompt_bounds_prompt_with_50_large_incidents and test_build_prompt_counts_omitted_incidents_when_total_limit_exceeded.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3: An open incident evidence_summary stays at or below 4000 characters however many evidence merges it receives; the newest incoming summary is always present and the kept text marks that older entries were dropped ([older entries dropped] marker). Once dropped, the marker is preserved across subsequent short and duplicate merges, duplicates leave stored summary unchanged, and kept tail aligns at whole field boundaries (; separator) without partial key=value entries. Verified in test_merge_incident_evidence_bounds_evidence_summary_at_4000 and test_merge_incident_evidence_truncated_summary_retains_marker_and_whole_field.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac4: A stored summary that is already longer than the limit is brought within it on its next merge without a data migration; telemetry_event_ids and reconciliation_ids still keep every id. Verified in test_merge_incident_evidence_reduces_existing_oversized_summary with a 100000+ char summary reduced to <= 4000 chars while preserving all IDs.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac5: Tests in the listed test files cover both limits and pass (94 passed); every existing monitor-agent and incident test still passes and no assertion is weakened.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac6: The structured route and the Gateway agent config and the admission guard are not changed.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac7: Net production line change is +28 lines (+14 in incident.py, +14 in monitor_agent.py) against a budget of 30, and no compressed code is used.

test_expectation_classification.details: All 88 pre-existing unit tests across services/incident/test_incident.py and services/monitor-agent/test_monitor_agent.py continue to pass without modification or weakening. 6 new comprehensive unit tests were added to verify prompt bounding, omitted incident counting, summary merge bounding, reduction of oversized pre-existing summaries, and preservation of marker, duplicate idempotency, and whole field boundaries on truncated summaries.
